statements.t: Continued enrollment in first-in-human Phase 1 clinical trial of STX-1150, the Company’s epigenetic silencing therapy for LDL-C lowering, with initial clinical data expected in the first half of 2027
A manuscript has been submitted to bioRxiv and will be available in the Publications section of the Company’s website once posted.
The company’s lead candidate, STX-1150, is a novel liver-targeted therapy designed to epigenetically silence the PCSK9 gene and reduce LDL-C levels without inducing permanent DNA changes.
